svg.title: CloudBSD Admin — Tooltip
svg.desc: Floating tooltip on hover with help text, dismiss link, and arrow pointing to trigger.

div.p: Hover/focus popover · dismissible · arrow anchors to trigger

div.class: bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 relative

div.div: When should zpool scrubs run automatically?

button.class: w-6 h-6 rounded-full border border-slate-300 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium

div.class: absolute z-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 top-full mt-2 w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-3 shadow-lg
absolute -top-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-3 h-3 bg-slate-900 rotate-45

div.p: ZFS scrubs verify data integrity by reading every block and repairing any corruption using a redundant copy.

div.div: Hover/focus the (?) icon to reveal the tooltip · Esc or focus-out dismisses

div.class: mt-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200

button.class: px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50

div.class: absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-full mb-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs rounded whitespace-nowrap
absolute left-full ml-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs rounded whitespace-nowrap
